elements.requirement: Unless otherwise agreed, a buyer who has goods delivered to them and rightfully refuses to accept them is not bound to return the goods to the seller.
elements.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, where goods are delivered to the buyer, and he refuses to accept them, having the right to do so, he is not bound to return them to the seller

elements.requirement: Where goods are delivered to a buyer who rightfully refuses to accept them, it is sufficient for the buyer to intimate to the seller that the buyer refuses to accept them.
elements.quote: it is sufficient if he intimates to the seller that he refuses to accept them

elements.requirement: Section 36 of the Sale of Goods Act 1979 does not apply to a contract to which Chapter 2 of Part 1 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015 applies.
elements.quote: This section does not apply to a contract to which Chapter 2 of Part 1 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015 applies
